svg.title: Five configuration decisions, 68x throughput
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “Five configuration decisions, 68x throughput” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. Five numbered serving configurations as boxes with proportional throughput bars beside them, climbing from a model loaded inside the handler at 2.3 requests per second and a p99 of 1,840 milliseconds, through an async def that blocks the event loop at 43, a threadpool fighting itself at 58, four uvicorn workers at 97 with p99 61 milliseconds, to micro-batching at 156 with p99 94; the first three are struck through and annotated with the specific mistake, and a bottom row contrasts liveness and readiness endpoints with a database-checking readiness probe crossed out.
svg.text: draw it from memory, then compare
